title: GTA 6's first confirmed actor is Stephen Root
description: Rockstar Games' GTA 6 has its first officially confirmed actor: King of the Hill's Stephen Root. Read the latest media report on the upcoming crime epic.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6's First Confirmed Actor Revealed: Stephen Root Joins the Cast

Rockstar Games has traditionally kept details regarding the voice and motion capture cast of its upcoming crime epic under wraps. While fans have spent months poring over trailers and speculating about potential actors, we now have our very first officially confirmed cast member for *GTA 6*. According to a recent report by media outlet Eurogamer, veteran actor Stephen Root, famously known for his work in *King of the Hill*, is attached to the highly anticipated title.

## Looking Ahead at the Cast

Stephen Root's involvement marks a significant milestone in the slow trickle of official information surrounding *GTA 6*. While Rockstar has not yet disclosed specific details about the character Root will be voicing or portraying, his extensive background in television, film, and voice acting suggests that *GTA 6* will continue the franchise's tradition of featuring top-tier talent. Root himself has expressed amazement at the project, noting that "It's an amazing thing to look at" based on his experience with the production.

As anticipation builds for the next installment in the blockbuster franchise, the confirmation of even a single cast member provides a fascinating glimpse into the scale of the game's development.

## Editor's Take

As a gaming editor, I believe that confirming Stephen Root's involvement is an exciting moment for the community. It gives us a tangible connection to the production side of *GTA 6* while we wait for Rockstar to share more comprehensive character trailers and official cast announcements.
